kills.property: For any collector, the balance subtracted after a successful Collect call equals exactly the amount sent to the collector, and any failed/reverted external call leaves the collector's balance unchanged; the buggy version subtracts before the external call, so a failing callee still reduces Acc[collector].balance.
kills.change_summary: Moved the balance subtraction from after the external call to before it, changing when Acc state is written relative to the callee.

kills.property: For any address, Collect must not permanently change the reentrancy guard: the reference leaves locked_ false so any later Collect call by an unlocked account with sufficient balance and elapsed unlock time can still succeed, while the bug leaves locked_ true forever so every subsequent call reverts.
kills.change_summary: Removed `locked_ = false;` in the nonReentrant_ modifier, permanently locking the contract after the first guarded call.

kills.property: For any Collect call, the caller's recorded Acc balance must not decrease unless the call actually succeeded and block.timestamp is strictly greater than the stored unlockTime; the buggy >= comparison allows withdrawal at exactly the unlockTime, so the balance decreases while the reference leaves it unchanged.
kills.change_summary: Changed `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` to `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime` in the Collect withdrawal condition.
